# Ernesto Cisneros Cino

> Ernesto Cisneros Cino: Cuban composer, pianist, digital artist, and writer based in Miami. This site (ernestocisneros.art) is his complete artistic and intellectual archive, available in 7 languages: EN (default), ES (/es/), FR (/fr/), IT (/it/), RU (/ru/), JA (/ja/), KO (/ko/). Main section pages include JSON-LD structured data (Person, Book, MusicAlbum, Article, BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage). All content is copyrighted by Ernesto Cisneros Cino; please attribute when referencing.

## Site Sections

- [Homepage](https://ernestocisneros.art/): Overview of the artist and entry to every section
- [Music](https://ernestocisneros.art/music.html): Albums: Mare Incognitum, Glacial Paths, Atlas of Fragmented Light, Sandbank, Trash, Velvet Alloy, Nocturne of Glass Currents, and other musical works
- [Books](https://ernestocisneros.art/books.html): Six published books, detailed below
- [Ideas](https://ernestocisneros.art/ideas.html): Essays on cosmology, philosophy, technology, culture, and the Cuba series (9 essays plus prologue)
- [NFT](https://ernestocisneros.art/nft.html): Digital art on Ethereum, Tezos, and Bitcoin Ordinals; profiles on SolPersona and objkt
- [Biography](https://ernestocisneros.art/biography.html): Full biography with Wikipedia, IMDb, and ORCID links
- [Impulses.art](https://ernestocisneros.art/impulses-art.html): Therapeutic music program for refugees and vulnerable communities
- [Contact](https://ernestocisneros.art/contact.html): Contact and collaborations

## Books

- [Sombras, Datos y Relampagos](https://ernestocisneros.art/books/sombras-datos-relampagos/): Shadows, Data and Lightning. Hybrid fiction/essay/poetry, Power Trilogy Vol. 1, Spanish, on Amazon Kindle. Themes: power, surveillance, invisible infrastructure, poetic intuition
- [La Sospecha Razonable](https://ernestocisneros.art/books/la-sospecha-razonable/): Reasonable Suspicion. Speculative fiction, 12 short stories, Power Trilogy Vol. 2, Spanish, on Amazon Kindle. Themes: reality questioning, philosophical speculation, strangeness of the everyday
- [Don't Turn Off the Light](https://ernestocisneros.art/books/dont-turn-off-the-light/): No apagues la luz. Psychological horror, 11 stories plus prologue, full bilingual web edition (EN/ES), $3.99 PDF, free to read online. Themes: psychological terror, the uncanny in everyday life, no supernatural elements
- [Huella](https://ernestocisneros.art/books/huella/): Footprint. Academic essay on the history of computing from clay tablets to quantum computers, Spanish, open access on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19589185)
- [La Necesidad de Creer](https://ernestocisneros.art/books/la-necesidad-de-creer/): The Need to Believe. Academic essay on 300,000 years of human spirituality and belief systems, Spanish and English, open access on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19588665)
- [Manual de bolsillo para sonidistas](https://ernestocisneros.art/books/manual-sonidistas/): Pocket Manual for Sound Engineers. Technical reference, 40 pages, Spanish, $4.00 PDF. Themes: gain, phase, EQ, compression, live sound, recording
